instantiate_Gemma2_2B: instantiate a Gemma2_2B transformer model with 26 layers and 2304 embedding dimension
instantiate_Gemma3_4B: instantiate a Gemma3_4B multimodal transformer model with SigLiP vision encoder
create_text_only_Gemma3: create a Gemma3 model with text_only=True to skip the vision encoder and save memory
inspect_model_config: inspect the TransformerConfig of a Gemma model class to view hyperparameters like embed_dim and num_heads
use_GEMMA3_ATTENTION_PATTERN: use the GEMMA3_ATTENTION_PATTERN constant to configure alternating local sliding and global attention layers
